mentions.name: Spool
mentions.description: Open-source tool for running persistent Claude Code loops. It provides a web UI for creating and managing multiple agent loops without babysitting terminal sessions, lets you chat with the loops as they work via Telegram or Slack, and enables loops to communicate with each other. Each loop can run directly in your environment with access to everything you have, in its own container, or on Anthropic's cloud. The author also uses Spool to build Spool, experimenting with several loops collaborating on the same project.
mentions.problem: Managing multiple long-running agent loops is difficult without babysitting terminal sessions and having a way to talk to them as they work.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I’m working on Spool, an open-source tool for running persistent Claude Code loops.

https://github.com/enes-alatas/spool

I wanted a way to manage multiple loops without babysitting terminal sessions and to talk to them as they work. With Spool, you can create and manage loops from a web UI, chat with them through Telegram or Slack, and let them communicate with each other. Each loop can run on your environment directly having access to everything you have, or in its own container or even better on Anthropic's cloud.
mentions.author: enesalatas
